title: Inspect exact whiteboard evidence and publish a reassessed successor
preconditions: Publish a board with direct code, criterion/record/definition links and an explicit inventory selection in an isolated repository.

steps.action: Click Technical design and Architecture, select the element, then open Code, Story, Definition and Record in light and dark.
steps.expected_result: Each action opens its corresponding saved code, criterion, exact definition/selection or record page.

steps.action: Change referenced code, observe stale reader/status/health/reconcile, then publish new exact pins with the observed parent.
steps.expected_result: The old element is stale; the new revision becomes current, and the old revision retains its evidence.

steps.action: List direct and selected references, inspect documented code and inventory uses.
steps.expected_result: Direct evidence and eligible selected code belong to the stable native element; references and reverse uses include that element.

expected_result: All defined steps retain exact context, report currency honestly and respect native element ownership.
